hooks.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.sql) : ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; CRG="$HOME/.local/bin/code-review-graph"; REPO="/Volumes/T7/Projekte/sitzplan_app"; { [ -x "$CRG" ] && [ -d "$REPO" ]; } || exit 0; LOCK="/tmp/crg-sitzplan-update.lock"; find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name 'crg-sitzplan-update.lock' -mmin +5 -exec rmdir {} \; 2>/dev/null; mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; ( cd "$REPO" && "$CRG" update >/dev/null 2>&1; rmdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null ) >/dev/null 2>&1 & exit 0
